name: Epic Welding and Manufacturing
old_description: Epic Welding & Mfg is a full service welding and fabrication shop located in West Fargo ND. We can take your projects from proto-type design to finished products. With over 20 years experience in the manufacturing industry our experienced staff we can handle your 1-10 piece orders or your 1-1,000 pieces; depending on what your requirements are at the time of an order.
about:
Epic Welding & Mfg is a full-service welding and fabrication shop based in West Fargo, North Dakota. The company has been operating for over 20 years, though a specific founding year is not publicly disclosed. Ownership details such as family, veteran, or woman-owned status are not indicated in available sources.

The shop provides a range of metal fabrication services under one roof, including MIG welding up to 450 amps, stick welding up to 400 amps, TIG welding, CNC plasma cutting of mild steel up to one inch thick, 12-foot press brake forming, plate shearing up to 1/4-inch by 10 feet, sawing with an 18-inch by 18-inch capacity, punching, notching, sand blasting, and epoxy painting using an automated two-part paint blender. It also offers assembly for industrial and agricultural equipment. Production runs span from single prototypes to batches of up to 1,000 pieces, with common outputs such as trailers, agricultural equipment, and pipe work.

Epic Welding serves customers in the industrial and agricultural sectors, fabricating custom metal components and assemblies for original equipment manufacturers, farm equipment builders, and other businesses requiring welded and formed steel, aluminum, or stainless steel parts.

The company emphasizes its ability to take projects from prototype design through finished products, offering in-house capabilities that cover cutting, forming, welding, blasting, painting, and assembly to reduce lead times and coordinate multi-step fabrication.
